text.p: UnionFed Financial Corp said its board had approved a plan to liquidate it after its holding company had gone into government receivership earlier this month.
UnionFed said the board would present the plan to its 800 shareholders "in the near future".
Federal savings bank Union Federal Bank has been in government receivership since August 9 after sustaining operating losses due to its high level of non-performing assets, it said.
The bank also had a "substantial" negative net worth, it said, adding that it had not been able to sell its assets.

UnionFed said it would use practically all of its $150,000 in assets to pay off its contractual liabilities and cover the cost of closing its operations. It said it did not expect to have any assets left over to distribute among its stockholders, who own 27.2 million shares outstanding.
